MiniMax H3
MiniMax H3 是 MiniMax 推出的通用多模态生成模型。该模型可同时理解文本、图像、视频与音频信息，能够生成带有原生立体音频的视频：人声、音效与音乐在单次前向传播中统一建模，而非后期分层叠加输出。视频输出最高支持 2K 分辨率、24 帧每秒，时长最长约 15 秒。
ComfyUI 相关链接
・ComfyUI#15224
・🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3
关于该工作流
核心输入项
・prompt（提示词）：集中描述镜头、运镜以及配套音频（对白、音效、音乐）
・width /height（宽 / 高）：通过分辨率选择器设置。H3 原生画布短边为 768 像素，最大分辨率上限为 768×1344 像素，尺寸数值需取 32 的整数倍
・duration (seconds)（时长，单位：秒）：由数学表达式节点转换为有效总帧数；模型以 24 帧每秒运行，每个区块固定 17 帧（17k+5），时长会向上对齐至适配该网格标准

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15-second 16:9 live-action cinematic science-fiction romance with the visual scale of a premium Western blockbuster, realistic adult actors, natural skin texture, restrained emotional performance, anamorphic lens flares, shallow depth of field, subtle handheld movement, and dramatic teal-blue versus amber lighting. Inside a collapsing mountaintop observatory, a giant vertical blue time rift floats in the central chamber. Its far side reveals a calm sunlit version of the same observatory, while the current world shakes beneath orange firelight, falling dust, loose papers, and cracking ceiling structures. A medium two-shot frames a fictional thirty-year-old man with short black hair, a dust-stained dark-gray long coat, and a small cut on his cheek, facing a fictional twenty-eight-year-old woman with short brown hair and a dark-blue coat. She grips his wrist with both hands and refuses to enter the rift. The camera pushes toward them with small amplitude at slow speed while the background destruction remains softly out of focus.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the camera cuts to an 85mm close-up of the woman (S1). Blue light from the rift moves across her tearful eyes while warm sparks glow behind her. Dust and a single tear mark her face; she maintains eye contact with the man and says in a quiet, urgent English voice: <d>[English] We still have time.</d> Her lips close after the final word as she tightens her grip on his wrist. Keep her performance controlled and realistic, never melodramatic.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of the man (S2). The unstable blue rift is reflected clearly in his eyes. He takes one restrained breath, looks briefly toward the collapsing ceiling, then returns his gaze to the woman. With a low, steady English voice that almost breaks at the end, he replies: <d>[English] Only one of us does.</d> His lips close, and his expression settles into quiet resolve rather than panic.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the camera cuts to a tight two-shot. The man gently holds the woman's face with both hands and presses his forehead against hers. For one brief second, the surrounding destruction becomes visually secondary and the camera holds nearly still on their breathing and eye contact. A violent structural impact shakes the chamber. Without warning, the man turns his body, keeps one hand behind her shoulder, and pushes her backward through the blue time rift. The camera trucks sideways with them, staying at medium-close distance and preserving both faces.

[Shot 5] At 00:11.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of their hands. The woman has crossed into the quiet sunlit observatory and immediately turns back. Their palms align on opposite sides of the semi-transparent energy membrane, fingers matching but unable to touch. Blue energy ripples outward from the point between their hands while the rift rapidly contracts. Their hands remain anatomically correct and physically separated by the membrane.

[Shot 6] At 00:13.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the woman on the safe side. She stares through the shrinking rift, breathing unevenly. Over her shoulder, the man stands alone in the amber-lit collapsing observatory, softly out of focus, offering one small restrained smile. The rift closes to a thin blue line and disappears without an explosion. The final blue reflection fades inside the woman's tear-filled eye as the camera pushes in with very small amplitude at slow speed. End at exactly 00:15.000. No additional dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no watermark, no famous actor likeness, no gore, no duplicated characters, no malformed hands, and no exaggerated crying.

overall_soundscape: Deep structural groans, distant impacts, falling debris, fluttering paper, low electrical resonance from the time rift, restrained breathing, and subtle fabric movement surround the dialogue. When the woman crosses the rift, the chaotic ambience becomes muffled and distant, followed by a soft energy pulse and near silence as the portal closes.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse piano notes and sustained low cello begin slowly, joined by restrained brass and deep cinematic pulses as the observatory collapses. The music rises during the forced separation, then drops to a single sustained string note and a faint piano tone for the final close-up.

# 工作流使用教程

## 本工作流：图生视频

基于参考图片和文字提示生成视频

## 操作步骤

1. 上传图片到「参考图1」
2. 上传图片到「参考图1」
3. 在「场景描述」填写提示词
4. 点击「运行」按钮开始生成

## 输入参数

- 「参考图1」上传参考图片
- 「参考图1」上传参考图片
- 「场景描述」描述视频中的场景和动作

## 注意事项

- 带标注的节点需要你手动操作，其余保持默认
- 图片建议使用清晰、分辨率适中的素材（512px以上）
- 提示词描述越详细，生成效果越精准
- 视频生成耗时较长，请耐心等待
- LoRA模型已预设好权重，无需调整
- 采样参数（步数/CFG等）已优化为默认值，一般无需修改
- 输出视频格式为MP4，可直接播放

※ 建议512px以上清晰图片
